frank.delta: Detached execution is viable on the actual Hostinger body, but naive one-writable-inode EUDI weakens OS-level immutable-root isolation. Do not promote single-file identity yet.
frank.next_test: Require EUDI security/recovery control to match or beat split immutable-root + mutable-state layout before integration.

unifieddb.delta: State mutation after memfd/fexecve detachment works and survives restart, but the writable inode itself does not enforce root/state byte-range separation.
unifieddb.next_test: Prototype least-authority state-writing mechanism that cannot pwrite root/model extents, then crash-cut it at every durability boundary.

claycode.delta: A logical MutableStateRegion type is insufficient if lowering produces a general O_RDWR file descriptor. Runtime capabilities must preserve bounded-write semantics below ClayCode.
claycode.next_test: Define and attack a bounded offset/range write capability whose lowered implementation cannot address immutable extents.

harness.delta: E1/E3 passed on Hostinger run 31397800061; E5 produced local counterevidence against naive same-inode isolation.
harness.next_test: Run E5 on target VPS and E4 kill-cut matrix. Treat a failed containment/crash test as a valid EUDI negative result.

q23.delta: Boot mechanics no longer block EUDI, but no GGUF/mmap performance evidence exists yet.
q23.next_test: Run identical embedded-vs-external model bytes and collect page faults, TTFT, throughput, RSS/PSS and GPU-offload behavior.

clayresearch.delta: H-EUDI-03 gained two independent environment observations (local Linux + Hostinger target); H-EUDI-05 gained counterevidence against naive single writable inode security.
clayresearch.next_test: Prioritize discriminators that can kill EUDI: range-confinement failure, crash inconsistency, corruption amplification or model-performance regression.

gwt.delta: Storage/boot mechanism evidence says nothing yet about cognitive causal equivalence.
gwt.next_test: Defer H-EUDI-09 until identical Frank state/model/runtime can execute matched split-vs-EUDI traces.

claygraph.delta: No graph result. Immutable-root protection and canonical STATE_HEAD remain independent of derived topology.
claygraph.next_test: Later inject graph/index corruption inside EUDI and prove rebuild cannot alter canonical root/state identity.

atomic.delta: Find a one-image design that preserves physical unity without handing a general writable inode capability to the cognitive runtime.
atomic.next_test: Explore brokered/range-bounded state writer, separate privileged writer process, kernel-enforced mappings, or reject strict one-file if the boundary cannot be recovered cleanly.

emergenz.delta: No emergence or consciousness evidence. This is substrate mechanics/security research only.
